name: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
summary: In Orgrimmar’s Valley of Honor, Ogunaro Wolfrunner tends the Horde’s foremost wolf kennel beside the Hunter’s Hall. He breeds and trains fierce wolves for orc champions and their trusted allies.

sections.title: Master of the Pack
sections.body: Ogunaro Wolfrunner tends Orgrimmar’s battle wolves beside the Hunter’s Hall in the Valley of Honor. Orcs and wolves have shared a bond for generations, across Draenor’s plains and Durotar’s wilderness. It rests on mutual respect, not simple domestication. Ogunaro entrusts only the hardiest beasts, from dire wolves to agile timber prowlers, to warriors who have proven their strength and worth to the warchief.

faq.answer: Ogunaro Wolfrunner is the Horde’s foremost wolf breeder and mount vendor, found outside the Hunter’s Hall in Orgrimmar’s Valley of Honor.

faq.q: Can anyone purchase a wolf from him?
faq.answer: Orcs can acquire wolves through their heritage once properly trained. Other Horde members must earn exalted standing and Orgrimmar’s utmost trust before Ogunaro parts with a wolf.

faq.q: What kinds of wolves does he provide?
faq.answer: Ogunaro provides black, brown, dire, and timber wolves, along with swift, armored breeds suited to veterans of war.

angles.text: For orcs, riding a wolf is an ancestral tradition that reaches back to the clans of Draenor. Ogunaro keeps that martial bond alive.
Trolls, tauren, and Forsaken must prove their dedication and honor to Orgrimmar before Ogunaro entrusts them with a wolf.
